subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Money Laundering Works
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: How Money Laundering Works.

hook.text: A drug cartel earns $50 million in cash. The problem: they can't spend it without being caught.

buildup.text: Money laundering turns illegally earned cash into clean money that appears legitimate.

discovery.text: The classic three steps: placement (deposit), layering (move), and integration (spend).

twist.text: An estimated $2 trillion is laundered globally each year — about 5% of world GDP.

climax.text: Despite massive regulation, less than 1% of laundered money is ever seized.

punchline.text: Dirty money cleans up better than it should.

quiz.question: What are the three classic steps of money laundering?
